decisions.what: Preserved the existing `runs` API and scanned input in order, extending a run only when the current string matches the last output value.
decisions.why: This encodes adjacent equal strings together while keeping nonadjacent repeats in separate runs.

decisions.what: Built a new list of tuple results without modifying the input.
decisions.why: This satisfies the non-mutation requirement and naturally returns an empty list for empty input.
